title: CS concierge brief — afternoon triage
content:
Purpose / quick context:
This is my pocket brief for the afternoon sweep — focused on 3 things: (A) making sure active renewals have single-threaded owners, (B) triaging high-impact support items to SRE/eng and setting expectations, (C) final QBR bullets to drop in slide deck for tomorrow. Quick, bullet-y, saveable as a template.

Top priorities (today):
- AcmeRetail (renewal 2026-07-15) — owner: Elise. Last touch: 6/15 kickoff with procurement. Needs final quote approval + regen of Dedicated sizing. Action: email procurement contact Natalia by EOD, include the 3-line uplift summary (size, cost delta, SLA). Prep: attach latency dashboard (p99, avg) and token-cost trend.
- NeoHealth (pilot -> enterprise) — owner: Jordan. Support flakiness w/ private deployment (KV cache invalidation) — ticket JIRA-7891. Action: sync w/eng (SRE on call: Priya) at 3:30p local, propose short rollback to previous model variant if root cause not found in 2 hours. Update customer with ETA 4:30p.
- EduStream (QBR prep) — owner: Riley. They asked for cost-per-inference improvement plan. Add 2 slides: current unit cost, recommended Optimize settings (batching + quant profile), predicted savings (10-28%).

Quick scripts / one-liners to use on calls:
- If asked about latency blips: "We currently route requests using latency-first policies; we observed a transient kernel scheduling issue that affected a subset of requests — we have a mitigation patch rolling and will follow up with timeline and postmortem."
- If asked about cost spikes: "Looking at your route breakdown, the majority of the token cost came from background retriever calls; we can reduce by caching 10-minute prefixes and rewiring the retriever call cadence."

Support follow-ups (shorthand):
- JIRA-7891 (NeoHealth): escalate -> Priya (SRE) + eng-serving-runtime #priority-high. Need log extract + model variant trace by 16:30.
- TKT-4523 (AcmeRetail): billing question, invoice line mismatch. Ops: ping finance@redwood for missing credit note. Put renewal hold note if unresolved by 6/25.
- TKT-4672 (RetailCo): stream stalls on long-run. Quick test: repro w/ sequence_len 2048 in staging, collect kernel trace. Assign: Riley.

QBR bullets to drop into deck (draft language):
- Adoption: active routes + avg monthly tokens (last 90d). Callout: 15% MoM growth driven by new checkout flow.
- Performance: p50/p95/p99 latency vs SLA (highlight wins + one transient regression).
- Reliability: incidents this quarter (summary + customer impact, mitigation + planned fix).
- Economics: current cost per 1000 tokens, recommended Optimize levers (batching, cache TTL, quant profile) and projected savings.
- Ask / decision needed: choose Dedicated sizing tier (S1 vs S2) and sign commitment form; timeline to enable production rollout for two-week canary.

Notes to self / meeting prep checklist (do before any customer meeting):
- Run the account route report & snapshot (use internal console) -> attach CSV.
- Refresh p99 latency shard & attach screenshot.
- Confirm renewal timeline with legal (if >50k commit).
- Draft 3 talking points for potential outage: cause, customer impact, remediation plan.

Unresolved / questions to escalate to AM or product:
- Can we offer a short-term cost credit for NeoHealth pilot if we push Dedicated start date? (AM to confirm ROI math).
- Does Optimize have an experimental quantization profile ready for transformer-xl models? Product reply needed by EOD to include in QBR.

Post-meeting follow-ups template (copyable) — short email body:
"Thanks for the time today — short recap and next steps: 1) action items with owners + ETA, 2) links to dashboards and the artifacts we showed, 3) planned follow-up touch (date/time). I’ll update the ticket and add the timeline."

Misc scratch notes:
- Reminder: add NeoHealth log snippet to JIRA for context.
- Keep AcmeRetail renewal draft in one thread to avoid confusion (procurement + finance + legal).
- Revisit internal playbook for KV cache TTL (maybe default 600s -> 120s for retail workloads).

End of brief — save as template for tomorrow's morning sweep.

Timestamped quick log (today):
- 09:10 AM: review AcmeRetail pricing doc, small changes noted.
- 11:45 AM: funnel sync (noted NeoHealth instability pattern).
- 02:05 PM: drafted QBR econ slide for EduStream.
- 03:30 PM: SRE sync scheduled (JIRA-7891).
summary: Afternoon triage pocket brief for CS — focused notes for renewals, urgent support items, QBR bullets, and templated follow-ups.
